question: JPEG is a commonly used method of lossy compression for digital images. What is the full form of JPEG?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Joint Photographic Experts Group__**.

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **JPEG stands for Joint Photographic Experts Group**__.

 __
 
• It is a computer graphics file format.
 
• JPEG is a lossy compression method widely used for digital photographs.
 
• In JPEG, the image is compressed to make a smaller file.
 
• Compression results in a loss of quality, however, so it is usually undetectable.
 
• JPEG files are widely used on the Internet, and JPEG is a popular digital camera format, making it ideal for non-professional printing and web use.
 
• JPEG format is best for web images, non-professional printing, e-mail, PowerPoint.
 
• The extensions ".jpeg" and ".jpg" are used for JPEG files.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **PNG** (Portable Network Graphics) files are a lossless picture format that was created to replace and improve upon the gif format.
 
• **GIF** files (Graphics Interchange Format) are used for web graphics and can be animated and transparent.
 
• **BMP **(Bitmap Image File) is a file format designed by Microsoft for Windows that does not compress or lose information, allowing images to have very high quality while simultaneously having very large file sizes.
